thread:
maya: Quick triage thread for next week's webinar. Need final topic pick + 3 abstracts + rehearsal slots. Can we do a 45m format with 20m talk + 20m live Qs + 5m CTA? :clock1:
jon: 45m sounds tight but good for conversion. My vote: "Practical inference patterns for product teams" - focus on routing & fallbacks.
eli: I drafted 3 abstracts, dropping them here:
1) "Launch-ready inference: routing, caching, and cost controls" - ops + product angle.
2) "SLA-first LLM serving: designing for latency and reliability" - SRE/infra angle.
3) "Eval-driven rollouts: preventing regressions in production" - ML/quality angle.
Which feels highest priority for our target buyer (app devs at scale)?
tess: Ops + cost (1) is best for the funnel we're targeting. Also pair with a short benchmark highlight in the middle (2 slides) to make it concrete.
maya: Agreed. Let's pick abstract 1. Who's the speaker? Jon you ok as lead, Eli co-presenter?
jon: Yep. I'll do lead + 10m keynote style. Eli can demo the caching config and cost graph.
eli: I'll prep a 6-min demo: before/after throughput & cost numbers, and a 1-slide fallback pattern.
ops-bot: calendar-bot: rehearsal rooms available Tue 9am PT and Wed 4pm PT. Note: webinar platform requires test stream 24h prior.
tess: Can we lock Tue 9am PT for full tech run? APAC folks might be late, but we need host+presenters.
maya: Locking Tue 9am PT. Action items:
- jon: final deck + 2 benchmark slides by Mon EOD
- eli: demo recording + fallback snippet by Mon EOD
- tess: run-of-show + Q moderation sheet by Mon EOD
- ops-bot: create webinar event, set recording, and enable closed captions
jon: Run-of-show rough (45m):
```
00:00-03:00 intro + house rules
03:00-13:00 keynote overview (jon)
13:00-19:00 demo & dive (eli)
19:00-35:00 moderated live Qs (tess)
35:00-40:00 quick CTA + trial link
40:00-45:00 optional xx follow-ups + close
```
maya: For inbound routing - tess, can HubSpot capture "attended_live" and "watched_recording"? We want follow-up playbooks.
tess: Yes. We'll use webinar SDK events to populate properties. Also set up 3 follow-up sequences: attended -> trial CTA, registered-no-show -> recording + nudge, watched-recording -> case study.
eli: Small ask: include a fallback slide with CLI snippets and a public low-bandwidth recording URL in case of stream issues.
jon: Will add. Also add 1-line speaker bios for the registration page.
maya: Great. If no objections, final deck & assets due Mon EOD, rehearsal Tue 9am PT. I'll update the calendar invite and registration copy. :rocket:
